title: CFA Level I
description: CFA Level I exam preparation: 180 multiple-choice questions across two 2-hour-15-minute sessions (4.5 hours total). Content structured by the 10 official topic areas; this course begins with Quantitative Methods.

exam_pattern.note: Topic weights are published by CFA Institute as approximate ranges and change periodically; verify current weights at cfainstitute.org before exam planning.

source: CFA Institute official exam information (cfainstitute.org) — public exam format and topic-area listings only; no curriculum text reproduced.
